name: 1 Apr 1948

references.label: Belfast Gazette issue 1386 (Keady Urban District (Alteration) Order, 1947 (confirmation))
references.note: 16 Jan 1948, page 15. Made 10 Jan 1948. In force: 1 Apr 1948. Confirms Armagh County Council's order of 2 Dec 1947 adding a small area (valuation lot in Dunlarg townland, Crossmore DED) to Keady UD.

references.label: Local Government Provisional Order Confirmation (Larne Borough Extension) Act (Northern Ireland) 1947
references.note: Local Act extending the Borough of Larne. Royal Assent 25 Nov 1947 (notice in Belfast Gazette issue 1381, 12 Dec 1947, page 320). The day the extension took effect is not stated in the notice; listed with the first 1 April edition after Royal Assent. Edition link inferred, not verified.

references.label: Census of Population of Northern Ireland 1951: Preliminary Report
references.note: Changes in administrative areas since 1937, Co. Antrim items (2), (4) and Co. Armagh items (6)-(7) (1 Apr 1948). Confirms the day the Larne Act reference leaves unstated.

references.label: Belfast Gazette, issue 1379, 28 November 1947, p. 295
references.note: Royal Assent 25 Nov 1947 to the Ministry of Health and Local Government Provisional Order Confirmation (Larne Borough Extension) Bill; notice of assent also Belfast Gazette, issue 1381, 12 December 1947, p. 320.

references.label: Urban Districts Boundaries (Procedure) Order (Northern Ireland) 1936 (S.R. & O. 1936 No. 170)
references.note: Made 9 Dec 1936 by the Ministry of Home Affairs under section 24 of the Local Government Act (Northern Ireland) 1934: the local inquiry and public notices required before a county council could make an order altering or defining the boundary of an urban county district. The Keady Urban District (Alteration) Order, 1947 is made under it (Belfast Gazette, issue 1386, 16 Jan 1948).

references.label: Belfast Gazette issue 1389 (Armagh Rural District (boundary alteration))
references.note: 4 Feb 1948, page 33. In force: 1 Apr 1948. District boundary altered: Rural District of Armagh'; places named: Armagh Rural District, Keady Urban District, Markethill, Richhill, County Armagh; by Ministry of Health and Local Government; in force 1 April 1948; under Local Government Act (Northern Ireland), 1934.

notes: 1 Apr 1948 reuses the converted geometry from 11 Jun 1946.

approximateSegments.note: Some lines on this map are approximate: parts of the Armagh urban district boundary are traced from the map deposited with the 1946 Order (about 20 m); parts of the Lurgan boundary are traced from the 1937 extension plan (about 25 m). They are drawn dotted on the map.
